description:
When the ready queue empties, next_ready_job (drive.rs:927-945) sweeps root_frontier and activation_frontier (drive.rs:866-918) whole: each set is cloned and sorted, and an entry that has not run is re-checked on every stall until it does. Nothing records how often that happens, so its cost cannot be measured. Peak sizes on Enum.take are small (activation_frontier 9, roots 3), but the pass count is unknown.

Add a drive.stalled telemetry event per sweep carrying the frontier sizes and how many entries started; teach tools/distill-telemetry.exs to report it; pin the count on the chain case and s1. If the count shows sweeps repeat over unrun entries, the fold of the two frontiers (proposed, not filed) gets a page.
title: The drive counts its stall sweeps
